subject: 外交實務英文寫作(以英文命題及作答)

essays.text: The United States has proposed hosting a Putin–Zelenskyy meeting inBudapest, while also intensifying tariff measures against European allies.Draft an official statement of approximately 500 words, analyzing how thesemoves may affect NATO cohesion and European stability, and how Taiwanshould calibrate its diplomacy accordingly. (25 points)

Compare the US withdrawal from the Trans-Pacific Partnership, its return tothe Paris Agreement, and its current tariff diplomacy. Draft an officialcommentary of approximately 500 words, assessing which approach bestserves global stability, and what lessons Taiwan should draw for its foreignpolicy. (25 points)

India and China have cautiously eased tensions despite unresolved border disputes.Draft a General Assembly resolution that emphasizes international adjudication,and regional dialogue. Include at least six operative clauses. (25 points)

With the UN Secretary-General describing Gaza as a “horror show,” write anofficial commentary of approximately 500 words that weighs humanitarianintervention against state sovereignty. Reflect on how Taiwan should approachsimilar debates in the UN system. (25 points)
